subject: Compliance documents — outstanding items and delivery plan
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@kindredhealth.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: security@kindredhealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: SIG items we still need from Redwood

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our InfoSec team finished an initial pass on the SIG intake and flagged a few deliverables we still need before we can finish the vendor review:

- SOC 2 (most recent report) or SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted OK)
- Executive summary of the most recent pen test (high/medium findings only)
- ISO statements or certificate scans (if available)
- High-level security deck that we can share with procurement (1–2 slides)

Can you confirm what you can provide this week and whether any of these require an NDA or secure transfer? Our procurement deadline is Dec 23.

Appreciate it —
Alice
Alice Wong
Senior Security Analyst
Kindred Health
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@kindredhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG items we still need from Redwood

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide all four items. A quick note on transfer and redaction: SOC 2 full report will need an NDA for the unredacted version; we can share a signed-summary PDF with scope and opinion now. Pen test summary is shareable and we will redact customer-identifying test artifacts. ISO statement is a signed attestation text file. Security deck is internal-friendly and suitable for procurement.

Planned deliverables and timeline:
- SOC2_Report-summary.pdf (scope + auditor opinion + control coverage) — delivered by EOD Wed 12/16
- PenTest_Summary.pdf (exec summary + remediations) — delivered by Thu 12/17
- ISO27001_statements.txt — delivered by Thu 12/17
- security-overview-deck-v2.pptx (2 slides + appendix) — delivered by Thu 12/17

Transfer method: we will upload the files to a secured SFTP bucket and send a time-limited link. If you need NDA first, we can sign the mutual NDA and then provide the full SOC2 report via SFTP.

I'll loop Karthik and Connor on redaction questions and the SFTP details.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG items we still need from Redwood

Grace — quick internal note before we push files:

- For SOC2 summary: legal prefers we remove specific subservice provider names and customer IDs; include auditor name, period, and control mapping only.
- Pen test: redact hostnames + internal IPs; include CVSS ratings for high/medium items, and status (open/closed).
- ISO statement: add the cert issue date and scope line.
- Deck: swap slide 2 appendix to include the caching/kv-cache note that procurement often asks about.

I'll prepare redaction templates and upload the finalized PDFs to the secure folder once Grace confirms. Also recommend we reference the HubSpot record DL-8392 in the deck footer.

-Karthik

On Wed, Dec 16, 2026 at 11:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — please go ahead with the templates.
